'''Tendrils''' were a type of plant-life<ref name="roots">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Dread Roots|[[Oricon]]}}</ref> found throughout the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]]. They grew from the root-seeds in the ground<ref name="roots" /> and could survive various hazardous environments; though usually growing from shallow waters, some tendrils could grow in lava,<ref name="makeb">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=location|[[Volcanic mesa]]|[[Makeb]]}}</ref> while others in the frozen snow<ref name="jannimak">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Gelid Tendrils|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>. Tendrils were a motile plant, capable of attacking animals or even moving underground to emerge in a different location. Some tendrils ended with a spike used in fighting.<ref name="makeb" /> Some lesser tendrils were known to have dielectric properties. These were often kept as home plants.<ref name="dielectric">{{TORcite|type=other|Decoration: "Dielectric Tendril"}}</ref>

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], fossilized tendril was found on many planets on which the tendril itself was extinct, such as [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] or [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="fossil">{{TORcite|type=other|"Fossilized Tendril", a gathering-skill world object found on various planets}}</ref>

[[File:TendrilOricon.png|left|thumb|200px|A corrupted Tendril on Oricon]]
During the [[Dread War]], [[Oricon]] became a birthplace of a new corrupted with the [[Dark side of the Force|Dark Side]] type of tendril. Covered in dark mist, much like [[Dark side tendrils|tendril manifestations of the Dark Side]], these corrupted tendrils became one of the [[Dread Masters]]' lines of defense, along with countless others corrupted species. Investigating these tendrils and digging up their roots, an adventurous spacer participating in the war managed to trace the source of corruption to the [[Bothrium Beast]], whom they slew to stop the spread of twisted plants.<ref name="haunted paradise">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=general|Haunted Paradise|[[Oricon]]}}</ref>

[[File:TendrilFrost1-SWTOR.png|thumb|200px|A psychrophilic tendril]]Around [[3622 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref> several psychrophilic tendrils were present on board of the [[research vessel]] ''[[Jannimak]]'', [[Crash of the Jannimak|crashed]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. In order to sustain the frost-loving organisms onboard, the ship's automatic systems [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] part of the [[Jannimak crash site|surrounding territory]] into a zone of extremely low temperatures, known as [[Glacial Trespass]].<ref name="jannimak" />
